# DataDashOS — full machine-readable guide
Version: 2026-11-18
Canonical site: https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/

## One-sentence definition
DataDashOS is a KPI dashboard and AI business coach that helps owners of small and mid-sized companies see performance in one place, review it every week, and act on what matters.

## Problem
Owners juggle accounting, CRM, marketing, and project data across separate tools. Reporting is manual, late, and rarely turns into action. Metrics lack meaning, and without a weekly review habit problems surface too late.

## Solution modules
1. Analytics dashboards — executive, marketing, sales, operations; prior-period and YoY comparisons; templates; dark/light mode.
2. Business OS & KPIs — industry blueprints, scorecards, targets, trends, CSV import, notes, AI forecasts.
3. Weekly reviews & execution — AI-written summaries, action items, notifications, branded reports.
4. Executive AI coach — CEO scorecard, decision briefs, coach chat grounded in KPIs, nine specialist roles.
5. Data connections — QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel, Google Ads, sync logs, privacy-safe demo mode.
6. Teams & administration — workspaces, invitations, roles, audit logs, white-label branding.

## Operating loop
Connect → Measure → Review → Act.

## FAQ corpus
Q: What is DataDashOS?
A: DataDashOS is a KPI dashboard and AI business coach for small and mid-sized companies. It unifies performance data, produces weekly reviews, and guides owners on what to do next.

Q: Who should use DataDashOS?
A: Owner-led SMBs that already run accounting, CRM, and marketing tools but need one weekly operating rhythm for decisions.

Q: What integrations are supported?
A: QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel, and Google Ads are first-class connections, with CSV import and a privacy-safe demo data mode.

Q: How is DataDashOS different from a BI dashboard?
A: Besides charts, DataDashOS adds industry KPI blueprints, AI weekly summaries, an executive coach grounded in your numbers, and an execution loop that turns insights into owned tasks.

Q: Is DataDashOS available to buy today?
A: Early access demos are open now. General self-serve pricing will follow later releases.

Q: Where is the company located?
A: Simmitri, Inc. operates in Northern California, USA, and has been in business for 32 years.
